description: This Java class 'PreviewBinPackingLayout' manages the layout of render previews in a bin packing manner within the Android Studio rendering tool. It calculates positions for preview elements, handles space allocation, and sorts previews by aspect ratio.

classes.name: PreviewBinPackingLayout
classes.description: A layout manager for arranging render previews in a bin packing style within the Android Studio rendering environment.

methods.name: performLayout
methods.description: Calculates and assigns positions to render previews based on available space, using bin packing algorithm.

methods.name: getLayoutHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the layout after performing layout calculations.
